projects.title: VR Laser Synth
projects.subtitle: Virtual Reality Gesture Mapping & Real-time DSP
projects.description: An immersive VR performance interface that translates controller data into the Csound audio engine. Built using a custom bridge between Unity and Csound, the system maps real-time spatial coordinates and rotation data to synthesizer parameters, allowing for expressive, gesture-based digital audio performance

projects.title: Risk of Rain 2 Mod - Sprint Double Bind
projects.subtitle: Runtime Assembly Hooking & Input Logic Injection
projects.description: A C# utility that extends the input capabilities of Risk of Rain 2 by bypassing the game's internal 1-to-1 keybinding constraints. By injecting custom listeners into the game’s core update loop, the mod enables asynchronous input polling for mouse-wheel and redundant key-mappings. This project focuses on improving player UX and accessibility, providing a solution for complex control schemes not supported by the native engine configuration.

projects.title: VideoCsound
projects.subtitle: MSc Thesis: Generating Music from Video with Computer Vision
projects.description: An open-source performance system that bridges computer vision and algorithmic composition to transform real-time visual input into synchronized, generative audio. Utilizing the YOLO11 object detection model and Csound audio engine, the system leverages high-level semantic data, such as object position and scale, to create an intuitive, marker-less musical interface.
